subjects.name: Science
subjects.description: Explore the natural world through observation, investigation and discovery.

topics.name: Circulatory system
topics.description: Discover how the heart and blood vessels keep the body supplied with oxygen.

activities.title: Inside the human heart
activities.description: Locate the heart, explore its 3D anatomy and work through a guided 12-stage virtual dissection.

activities.title: Circulatory system: revision simulator
activities.description: Build confidence with varied multiple-choice questions, explanations and focused practice on the questions you missed.

topics.name: Breathing system
topics.description: Explore the airways, investigate how the lungs ventilate, and see how gases pass between alveoli and blood.

activities.title: Inside the breathing system
activities.description: Explore respiratory anatomy, control a breathing simulation and investigate gas exchange at the alveoli.

activities.title: Breathing system: revision simulator
activities.description: Practise ventilation, gas exchange and lung-health questions with immediate explanations or an end-of-test review.

topics.name: Gas laws
topics.description: Investigate how pressure, volume and temperature are linked in a fixed amount of gas.

activities.title: Gas laws: the particle lab
activities.description: Explore Boyle–Mariotte, Charles and Gay-Lussac laws with a movable piston, live graphs, recorded measurements and guided challenges.
